title: Playboy Magazine December 1986 Gala Christmas Issue - Some Pages Coming Off
descriptionText: The Playboy Magazine December 1986 Gala Christmas Issue is a holiday-themed edition featuring topics related to country. Despite some pages coming off, this vintage magazine makes for a nostalgic and collectible item for fans of Playboy and classic holiday issues. The publication is in Finnish language and was released in October 2011, offering readers a unique glimpse into the pop culture and lifestyle of the time.
